description: Borel–Padé of 4_1 Ohtsuki series: locate the instanton action A (f-map Stokes datum); test complex 𝔙=Vol±iCS.

result.verdict: CORRECTION of #3478: the 4_1 resurgence action is REAL-POSITIVE, not complex — FORCED by amphichirality (4_1 amphichiral ⇒ CS=0 ⇒ 𝔙=Vol real). Clean order-11 κ ladder (dps 220, Vol rec rel 5.97e-29) has κ_k all positive + monotone, CONSISTENT WITH (not a proof of) a real-positive dominant singularity (a small-phase complex pair would not yet flip signs by order 11). The large-order ratio A_k=k·κ_{k-1}/κ_k Richardson-extrapolates to A≈0.693749 (closest framework value 2/e, rel 0.0571). The #3478 order-6 'complex/oscillating |A|≈0.5' read was low-order fit noise (κ_4,5 imprecise at dps 100). Borel–Padé nearest-pole is Froissart-unstable (jumps 0.71→0.049→0.049+0.12j across M) — reported as cross-check, NOT used for A. A is the f-map's Stokes datum. Still order-limited (κ to 11); an exact saddle expansion to ~20 orders would pin the candidate match. No fit to QOU data; no c_k value; no wiring; no tier change.
